component.name: perseus-ctx
component.description: Perseus Context Engine, a Python workspace-context renderer with optional MCP and integration surfaces.

properties.name: perseus:sbom:scope
properties.value: RUNTIME (distributed) dependencies only. PyYAML is unconditional; tomli is conditional for Python <3.11. The development/CI/packaging toolchain (pytest, mypy, poetry, twine, etc.) is documented separately in SBOM.md and is NOT part of any shipped artifact.

components.name: python
components.description: CPython interpreter used by the reference distributed runtime image. The package supports Python >=3.10.

components.name: PyYAML
components.description: YAML parser/emitter. The unconditional third-party runtime dependency; requirements-runtime.txt pins 6.0.3 and pyproject.toml permits >=6.0.1,<7.

properties.name: perseus:sbom:hash-note
properties.value: SHA-256 is for the reference pin pyyaml 6.0.3 cp312 manylinux x86_64 wheel; the aarch64 wheel is 9149cad251584d5fb4981be1ecde53a1ca46c891a79788c0df828d2f166bda28.

components.name: tomli
components.description: TOML parser fallback used on Python <3.11 when stdlib tomllib is unavailable.
